_meta.source: data_dictionary.csv of 'Soil Macro Nutrient Dataset for Fertilizer Combinations Advice, Pune' (Vispute et al., Mendeley Data, CC BY 4.0)
_meta.note: status 'documented' = name from the dataset's data dictionary. status 'inferred' = the code is not in the dictionary; its meaning was worked out from the data on 20 Oct 2026 (see 'evidence'). Key finding: the last letter of Combination 1 always matches the last letter of Combination 2 on the same card (P with P, M with M, none with none), so each letter keeps one meaning: U = Urea, S = Super phosphate (SSP), D = DAP, P = Potash (MOP), M = Mixture, N = Nitrogen/NPK source, A = Ammonium sulphate (inferred).
_meta.dose_option: Which calculated product set best matches the combination: 'dap' = DAP + Urea + MOP, 'ssp' = SSP + Urea + MOP, null = no direct match.

USP.name: Urea + Super Phosphate
USP.note: Dictionary name is 'Urea Super Phosphate'. The trailing P very likely means Potash: USP always pairs with potash codes (NUP, DUP, AUP), while US (no P) pairs only with no-potash codes.

USM.name: Urea + Super Phosphate + Mixture
USM.note: The dataset defines M only as 'Mixture'; M is not potash (it appears on high-K soils) and not linked to micronutrient deficiency.

US.name: Urea + Super Phosphate (no potash)
US.evidence: Always paired with no-potash Combination 2 codes (NU, NS, DU, N); used for groundnut and ragi, whose official doses contain no potash (25:50:0, 80:40:0). It is USP without the P (potash).

AUP.name: Ammonium sulphate + Urea + Potash
AUP.evidence: A is not in the dictionary. Every AUP soil is low in sulphur and 76% are very low in nitrogen; ammonium sulphate supplies both N and S. Used for maize and sugarcane.

DU.name: DAP + Urea (no potash)
DU.evidence: DUP without the P (potash). Appears only for groundnut (no potash in its dose) and only on high-potassium soils.

DUM.name: DAP + Urea + Mixture
DUM.evidence: DUP pattern with M instead of P; pairs with USM. M follows the dictionary's 'Mixture' (from USM). Exact mixture grade unknown.

N.name: Nitrogen source only
N.evidence: Only 2 soil-crop pairs (jowar), all on high-nitrogen soils with low phosphorus. Pairs with US (no potash).

NM.name: Nitrogen + Mixture
NM.evidence: Pairs with USM; only 3 soil-crop pairs (gram, sugarcane). Exact mixture grade unknown.

NUM.name: Nitrogen + Urea + Mixture
NUM.evidence: NUP pattern with M instead of P; always pairs with USM. Exact mixture grade unknown.
